days.label: Day 1
days.title: Arrive in Pelling
days.text: Drive from NJP or Bagdogra and settle in for a first look at the peaks.

days.label: Day 2
days.title: Pelling sights
days.text: Pemayangtse Monastery, Rabdentse ruins and the Chenrezig statue and Skywalk.

days.label: Day 3
days.title: To Yuksom
days.text: Drive to Yuksom, Sikkim's first capital, and walk to Dubdi Monastery.

days.label: Day 4
days.title: Yuksom slow day
days.text: Village walk and a free afternoon.

days.label: Day 5
days.title: Khecheopalri Lake
days.text: The wishing lake and a short forest trail on the way back.

days.label: Day 6
days.title: Departure
days.text: Breakfast, then a drop to NJP or Bagdogra.
